# Gramlot 0.3.7 — Shared Source identity spelling

Source identity is now `nodeId` in Python and JavaScript. Declarations, lookup,
symbolic references, live identity changes and qualified subscriptions use the
same attribute throughout Builder and Gramlot. DOM `id` remains independent.

This is a breaking authoring change: replace `node_id` with `nodeId` in pages,
direct attribute accesses and metadata templates, and regenerate saved Source.
There is no compatibility alias. The package requires the matching migrated
dependencies; upgrade Gramlot and its examples together.

System callbacks `_onCalling`, `_onResult`, `_onError` and namespaced names
`node_label`, `node_position`, `target_id` retain their existing spelling. Other
naming proposals are deferred.
